messages.settings.battery_pv_info: Off by default. Requires PV charging and battery support. Starts two percentage points above the higher battery floor and stops at that floor. An interrupted surplus resets the timer. Battery charging is blocked and self-consumption discharge allowed during assistance. Sustained grid import stops assisted charging; brief control transients may occur.

messages.notice.wallbox_stop: Charging stop unconfirmed; vehicle may still be charging

messages.control.restart_info: Control permission is retained across restarts. When enabled, the Energy Dashboard waits for valid readings and an EOS battery plan before resuming. Control remains off after controller errors.

messages.settings.battery_limits_failed: EOS did not confirm battery limits. Synchronization will be retried; local limits are saved.
messages.settings.battery_limits_unmanaged: Not sent to EOS yet. Save to enable synchronization of these battery limits.

messages.chart.energy_forecast_note: The house forecast includes all consumers. Separate house and heat pump forecasts are only shown when available; missing values remain empty.

messages.fleet.forecast_note: Select a vehicle for its SoC, EOS modes and measurements. Resource-specific EV power/SoC forecasts are not available in the legacy EOS solution; no shared curve is assigned to individual vehicles.
messages.mode.waiting_measurements: Waiting for grid and charger readings
messages.metric.waiting_car_power: Previous reading · waiting for vehicle power
messages.control.cached_eos: Active · cached EOS plan, up to 5 minutes
messages.billing.partial: Missing measurement intervals are not reconstructed. Known costs are a subtotal if any costs are unknown.
messages.billing.unknown_cost: Some energy costs are unknown; shown costs are the known subtotal.
messages.billing.title: Consumption & costs
messages.billing.variable: Variable energy costs · excludes fixed fees
messages.billing.no_data: No recorded measurement intervals in this period.
messages.billing.method: Sources are allocated proportionally to simultaneous consumers, battery charging and export. Battery energy uses a weighted cost inventory including charge/discharge losses.
messages.billing.inventory_note: Initial battery energy without a purchase price is estimated once as PV charging at the PV cost basis. Missing tariffs and later data gaps remain unknown. Historical estimates are not an electricity bill.
messages.billing.initial_price: Initial stored energy price (ct/kWh; blank = PV estimate)
messages.billing.efficiency_missing: EOS battery data unavailable: storage costs remain unknown. Select manual settings if needed.
messages.billing.settings_note: Changes apply to future intervals only. Initial price applies only at first initialization. Without an override, unknown initial stock is valued once at the PV cost basis including charging losses; unknown remaining stock is also valued on upgrade. Known costs are preserved. Manual efficiency/capacity values apply only in manual mode. The PV cost basis defaults to the EOS feed-in tariff. Negative costs are supported.
messages.billing.reconstructed: Older Influx measurements are estimated from five-minute means; the initial storage cost is unknown.
messages.billing.history_error: Influx history unavailable; showing the local ledger only.
messages.billing.pv_missing: EOS feed-in tariff unavailable; costs remain unknown.
messages.error.bridge_not_ready: Home Assistant is still connecting. Please wait briefly.
messages.error.not_ready: The integration is still loading or is not active. Wait briefly; if this persists, check the integration in Devices & services.
messages.error.timeout: Home Assistant did not respond within 30 seconds. Check the connection and retry.
messages.error.unauthorized: Access denied. Open this panel with a Home Assistant administrator account.
messages.error.unknown_command: The integration API is unavailable. Reload the integration or restart Home Assistant after updating.
messages.error.language_invalid: The language pack is incomplete or invalid. Update the complete integration, including the i18n folder.
messages.error.language_unavailable: The language pack could not be read. Check that the integration files were copied completely.
messages.error.history_unavailable: History could not be loaded. Current readings can still be available; check the history/database connection.
messages.error.history_invalid: The history response could not be processed. Check the integration log.
messages.error.invalid_report: The report request is invalid. Check the period, date and cost settings.
messages.error.report_unavailable: Consumption and cost data are temporarily unavailable. Device control is independent of this report.
messages.error.internal_error: An internal integration error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for the affected action.
messages.error.asset_mismatch: UI files have different versions. Update the complete integration and retry to reload all UI files.
messages.startup.view: The interface could not be displayed
messages.startup.unexpected: An unexpected browser error occurred. Reload the UI; if it persists, check the technical details.

messages.notice.runtime: A device command failed; check the integration diagnostics and log.
